mcqs.q: Charge through 2 A wire in 5 s (C):
What happens to the total resistance when you add another resistor in parallel?
options: Charge was created by friction and pulled the balloon to the wall.
Adding a parallel resistor doubles the voltage available.
Total resistance decreases — there are more paths for current to flow.
Adding any resistor always increases the total resistance.

mcqs.q: When you rub a balloon and stick it to the wall, what has been transferred?
options: Protons jumped from the balloon to the wall, causing static cling.
Electrons have been transferred between the balloon and the cloth (not the wall).
Charge was created by friction and pulled the balloon to the wall.
Current splits in half at the battery so each direction gets some.

mcqs.q: What happens to the current as it goes around a series circuit?
options: It stays the same at every point — current is conserved.
Charge was created by friction and pulled the balloon to the wall.
Current splits in half at the battery so each direction gets some.
Current gets used up by each component as it flows around the circuit.
